/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd
xls = pd.ExcelFile('national_programme_ledger.xlsx')
# Field Expenses
fe_raw = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=None)
fe_header_idx = 4
fe_cols = fe_raw.iloc[fe_header_idx].tolist()
fe_data = fe_raw.iloc[fe_header_idx+1:].copy()
fe_data.columns = fe_cols
fe_data = fe_data[['Transaction ID','Cost Centre','Amount (INR)','Posting Status']].copy()
# Salary
sal_raw = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=None)
sal_header_idx = 5
sal_cols = sal_raw.iloc[sal_header_idx].tolist()
sal_data = sal_raw.iloc[sal_header_idx+1:].copy()
sal_data.columns = sal_cols
sal_data = sal_data[['Payroll Line ID','Cost Centre','Gross Salary (INR)','Payroll Status']].copy()
# Lookup
lookup_raw = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=None)
lookup_header_idx = 3
lookup_cols = lookup_raw.iloc[lookup_header_idx].tolist()
lookup_data = lookup_raw.iloc[lookup_header_idx+1:].copy()
lookup_data.columns = lookup_cols
lookup_data = lookup_data[['Cost Centre Code','Programme']].dropna()

def norm(s):
    if pd.isna(s): return ''
    return str(s).strip().lower()

lookup_data['norm_code'] = lookup_data['Cost Centre Code'].apply(norm)
lookup_map = {row.norm_code: row['Programme'] for _,row in lookup_data.iterrows()}

# Process field expenses
fe_data['norm_cc'] = fe_data['Cost Centre'].apply(norm)
fe_data['norm_status'] = fe_data['Posting Status'].apply(norm)
fe_filtered = fe_data[(fe_data['norm_status']=='posted') & (fe_data['norm_cc'].isin(lookup_map))]
fe_filtered['Programme'] = fe_filtered['norm_cc'].map(lookup_map)
fe_sum = fe_filtered.groupby('Programme')['Amount (INR)'].sum()

# Salary
sal_data['norm_cc'] = sal_data['Cost Centre'].apply(norm)
sal_data['norm_status'] = sal_data['Payroll Status'].apply(norm)
sal_filtered = sal_data[(sal_data['norm_status']=='paid') & (sal_data['norm_cc'].isin(lookup_map))]
sal_filtered['Programme'] = sal_filtered['norm_cc'].map(lookup_map)
sal_sum = sal_filtered.groupby('Programme')['Gross Salary (INR)'].sum()

combined = fe_sum.add(sal_sum, fill_value=0)
combined = combined.sort_values(ascending=False)
print(combined)
print('Highest:', combined.idxmax(), combined.max())
\""

import pandas as pd, re
def parse_amount(x):
    if pd.isna(x): return 0
    s=str(x)
    # remove currency symbols, commas
    s=re.sub(r'["'^'"\\d.]','', s)
    try:
        return float(s)
    except:
        return 0

xls = pd.ExcelFile('national_programme_ledger.xlsx')
fe_raw = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=None)
fe_header_idx=4
fe_cols=fe_raw.iloc[fe_header_idx].tolist()

fe_data.columns=fe_cols
fe_data=fe_data[['Transaction ID','Cost Centre','Amount (INR)','Posting Status']].copy()
fe_data['Amount_num']=fe_data['Amount (INR)'].apply(parse_amount)

sal_raw=pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=None)

def norm(s):

    return str(s).strip().lower()

lookup_data['norm_code']=lookup_data['Cost Centre Code'].apply(norm)
lookup_map={row.norm_code:row['Programme'] for _,row in lookup_data.iterrows()}

fe_data['norm_status']=fe_data['Posting Status'].apply(norm)

combined=fe_sum.add(sal_sum, fill_value=0)
